name: io.github.wirebench/wirebench
title: Wirebench
description: Send, check and diff SOAP, REST, WebSocket and MCP requests in a local Wirebench project.

packageArguments.description: Serve the project's tools over MCP.

packageArguments.name: --project
packageArguments.description: The Wirebench project folder, the one holding wirebench.yaml, as an absolute path.
Let send and the contract tools make requests. Without it they refuse.

packageArguments.name: --env
packageArguments.description: The environments send may use, comma-separated. Every other environment is refused.
